## Description

Applies contractive autoencoders with Jacobian penalty regularization to compress market feature panels into robust latent representations, triggering risk-off alerts when reconstruction error spikes.

## Where it may fit

Sudden market regime shifts, abnormal volatility spikes, liquidity dry-ups.

## Vehicles

Systematic risk management desks, multi-strategy hedge funds.

## Required data

Multivariate asset pricing, trading volume, volatility indices, and order book imbalance features.

## Caveats

Contractive penalty weight must be calibrated to ensure sensitivity without excessive false positive alerts.
